title: Condition-dependent protein abundance
description: 48 proteins with the greatest abundance range across the 22 growth conditions in published Table S5 (dataset 2). All selected proteins have positive measured estimates in every condition; full table contains 2058 proteins.
processing: Read Table S5. First 22 condition columns are protein copies/cell; subsequent repeated column groups are excluded. Select complete positive rows, then 48 highest max/min abundance ratios. Preserve estimates unchanged. x=Glucose and y=LB. No genomic coordinates inferred.

limits: These are model-calibrated abundance estimates from mass spectrometry, not literal cell counts.
Selection favors strongly condition-responsive proteins and is not a whole-proteome allocation total.
A treemap shows only the selected proteins; show its denominator explicitly.
No gene-coordinate mapping is applied across the different E. coli strains.
